name: Lenovo Legion 4-Zone Keyboard
description: The four-zone keyboard backlight of Lenovo Legion 5 (2020-2023) and IdeaPad Gaming laptops (ITE 048D, usage page 0xFF89 / usage 0xCC). Adapted from OpenRGB's Lenovo4ZoneUSBController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Only the lighting report (CC 16) is ever sent. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/lenovo-legion-4zone.md.
